meta.title: [alpha_factory] switch business bridge to httpx
meta.body_summary: Replace synchronous requests library with httpx.AsyncClient for the business demo bridge, adapting functions to async/await and updating tests.

perf_labels.notes: No review or benchmark data; quick self-merge of small httpx async migration with narrative performance expectation.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 239 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume, concentrated in one primary bridge file. The quick self-merge without review is consistent with a low-risk library swap.

review_details.concern_detail: No review text available; PR merged without external feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Switching from synchronous requests to async httpx improves responsiveness and throughput for business demo agents.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Async HTTP client swap requires correct async/await handling; agent succeeded without review, suggesting straightforward migration for this codebase.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body only provides test commands, no timing data or profiler output.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR merged without regression handling despite pytest -q failures that are apparently pre-existing.

core_change_summary.description: In openai_agents_bridge.py, replace requests library with httpx.AsyncClient, make functions async and add wait helpers; adjust llm_provider.py metrics registration; update tests with AsyncClient mocks.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: llm_provider change is unrelated hardening; test changes support new httpx mocks.
change_trajectory: Single commit switches bridge to httpx, adapts helpers to async/await, and patches tests.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with a single commit; merged 11 seconds later by the same user; no review or comment interaction.
